svg.text: Three jumpers — 3V3, DATA on GPIO 4, and ground
1. VCC lands in column 10, DATA in 11, GND in 12.
2. Red jumper: 3V3 to column 10. Orange: GPIO 4 to column 11. Black: GND to column 12.
The module has the pull-up resistor built in. The bare four-pin sensor needs 10 kΩ between VCC and DATA.
3.3 V, not 5 V — the ESP32 pins are not 5 V tolerant. And read it no faster than every two seconds.
